thread:
nina: Proposal: run a hands-on webinar: 'Demo Resilience Lab: live failovers & economical serving'. Goal: teach engineers how to build demos that survive load spikes and keep $/latency predictable. Open to feedback.

rahul: love the lab framing. buyers remember a path they can replicate. target audience = infra/feature teams.

amy: happy to operate the live demo and fault injection. I have a lightweight demo harness we can reuse. available May 9-11 afternoons PT.

kevin: I'll own the benchmark slide pack. short, actionable metrics only: median/p95 latency, tokens/sec, cost per 1k, and a waterfall of where time/cost goes.

nina: speaker split idea: quick framing (nina), benchmark & takeaways (kevin), live lab + fault injection (amy). rahul can moderate and collect audience questions.

rahul: yep I'll host and run the audience poll. suggested poll: "If you had to optimize one thing today, what would you pick? (batch size / quantization / cache)". keeps folks engaged.

amy: demo needs: 3 short prompts, a pre-built image, and a whitelist for the demo runner. I'll post the prompts in a sec.

nina: run-of-show draft:
```
00:00 - Welcome + what to expect (nina) 4m
04:00 - Buyer story & architecture primer (nina) 6m
10:00 - Benchmarks & quick rules of thumb (kevin) 8m
18:00 - Poll (rahul) 1m
19:00 - Live lab: baseline + tweak knobs (amy) 15m
34:00 - Inject fault: overload -> fallback routing (amy) 6m
40:00 - Postmortem: what changed & cost delta (kevin) 5m
45:00 - Open Qs + next steps (panel) 15m
```

kevin: prefer this condensed timeline. also add a 1-slide maturity checklist at the end for adoption.

nina: rehearsals: tech dry run May 2 2pm PT, full dress May 6 10am PT. Can ppl confirm?

amy: May 2 confirmed for tech. May 6 tentative but should be ok.

kevin: confirmed May 6 full run. I'll bring the sample numbers.

rahul: I'll schedule both and add 3 seed Qs. also will prepare the engagement poll in the webinar tool.

ci-bot: Staging env allocated May 2 14:00 PT for 90 minutes. Auto-reminder 24h before.

nina: preflight checklist (short):
- slides in drive + presenter's notes
- demo container image tag + sha
- IP whitelist for demo runner
- fallback model variant and routing policy configured
- sample telemetry dashboard URL
- backup recording of demo steps (video)

amy: posting demo prompts and a tiny dataset to drive: https://rwd.infer/demo-lab-cases. prompts are: 
- "Summarize the product spec in 3 bullets."
- "Shorten this customer email to a 2-line ask."
- "Given these latency traces, recommend top 2 remediation steps."

kevin: I'll share a dashboard snippet: p50/p95, tokens/s, model cpu/gpu util, and cost delta pre/post-fallback. sample numbers by EOD Friday.

rahul: marketing copy ideas (quick):
H1: "Demo Resilience Lab: keep live LLM demos online under pressure"
Subhead: "Practical knobs, real metrics, and a live failover you can copy."
CTA: "Sign up" + form field: "Primary constraint".

nina: clean. prefer single CTA. amy please confirm you can accept form responses mapped to the poll.

amy: yes, webinar platform can prefill and sync poll answers.

rahul: owners: slides/nina, benchmarks/kevin, demo/amy, host/rahul. I'll create calendar invites and a gating checklist doc.

kevin: will post slide drafts and the benchmark notes by Thursday EOD.

amy: ops ask: need IP whitelist and a temporary service account for the demo connection. tagging infra to approve.

nina: final note: keep messaging pragmatic and engineer-first. short code snips for the fallback policy will be useful. I'll draft the registration page copy this afternoon and share. :rocket:
